target.title: fix(crestodian): suppress unhandled stdout/stderr stream errors in probeLocalCommand
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`probeLocalCommand` attaches `data` listeners to `child.stdout` and `child.stderr`, but does not attach `error` listeners. If either stream emits an `error` event, the unhandled error can crash the OpenClaw process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add no-op `error` handlers to both stdout and stderr streams after the data handlers. Stream read errors are treated as non-fatal because the child process `error`/`close` handlers already report the real outcome.

## Changes

- **`src/crestodian/probes.ts`** — add `child.stdout.on("error", () => {})` and `child.stderr.on("error", () => {})` (2 lines)

## Evidence

Regression test:

```bash
node --import tsx/esm scripts/proof/probes-stream-errors.mts
```

```
==============================================================
Proof: stream error handlers in probeLocalCommand
==============================================================

Test 1: Normal probeLocalCommand with a real command
  found=true, version=v1.0.0, error=none
  ✅ PASS: Normal probeLocalCommand still works after fix

Test 2: Stream error on stdout does not crash
  stdout received: "version output"
  ✅ PASS: Process did not crash on stream error (handler suppressed it)

==============================================================
✅ PROOF PASSED — probeLocalCommand handles stream errors safely
==============================================================
```
